Please give your advice on this. Question: Assalamualaikum, kindly give us fatwa for the below mention question We are constructing a Residential Hotel in Mumbai, we would like to know that can we give a BAR Room in the Lobby Area and give some one on Rent to Run the BAR, we will not take the income of BAR. Please give your advice on this. Regards, YASIN BALWA 9820216417 Answer ID: 26019 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2386/H=823/th=1431) You are strictly advised not to construct such Bar Room, though you will not take the income, then too do not make it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
